details:
Beginning around 10/10/26, I have been experiencing a unique crash which initially involved EAC reporting outdated .dll files as suspicious items and would force-close the game. The crashes would happen when I would only join a specific world and only during a Group+ instance that had around 10 people or more in the instance. 

This is the world: 

https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_75ac07b8-64f7-43cf-9adc-30ab4e0d3654/info

This is the group:

https://vrchat.com/home/group/grp_e9822c77-cf48-435d-88e9-93855b8bf9f5

1. Log In

2. Open Menu

3. Groups -> Group Instances

4. Join

5. Loading -> Connecting -> Joining.... Crash.

6. (Sometimes) EAC error popup saying XYZ.dll is an untrusted file. I have since removed the offending files that would pop-up as they were leftovers from games I do not even play anymore. Since removing them, I no longer get the EAC popup, but I still get the crashing.

Recently, about two days ago, I experienced a very different issue with this same world in which when I would try to join I would NOT crash, but I would instead be placed in a Friends instance of the same world when trying to join the Group+ instance.

1. Log In

2. Open Menu

3. Groups -> Group Instances

4. Join

5. Loading -> Connecting -> Joining

6. "You have joined a Friends instance."

It's a completely separate instance; I did not go through the steps of creating one myself. I just tried joining a group instance. When I try to join the group instance from this friends instance, it either puts me in a new Friends instance of the same world again or sends me to my Home instance. I spoke to the world creator about this issue already and they believe it is an issue with EAC. After uninstalling/reinstalling EAC multiple times I still experience these issues.
title: Strange Instance Crash/Rerouting
